notes_for_editor: Very thin. The Forest Lookouts page for Oxly carries only its heading, so no build date, height, agency, staffing or fate was found. The map entry is a map-database record, not evidence about the structure, and it does not show whether the tower stands. Two web searches found nothing more; the NHLR and FFLOS caches do not list Oxly. The story is about 110 words, at the thin end of the guide's range, on purpose; do not pad it. The map entry's name should not be read as confirmation that a tower stands.
